findings.source: Vigilante: Шире, шире давай раскрывай их. Ручками, давай!
findings.currentTarget: Vigilante: Ifungue zaidi, zaidi. Tumia mikono yako, haya!
findings.proposedFullTarget: Vigilante: Yafungue zaidi, zaidi. Tumia mikono yako, haya!
findings.objectiveReason: The object is the player’s eyes (macho, class 6), confirmed by the immediately following ShowPlayerSign EYE. Ifungue uses class 9/4 object agreement instead of ya for these plural eyes. Preserve the hands instruction and impatient repetition.

findings.source: Twins: Спасибо. Осторожно, под спину ей руку… Вот так.
findings.currentTarget: Twins: Asante. Kwa uangalifu, mweke mkono mgongoni… Hivyo.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Twins: Asante. Kwa uangalifu, weka mkono chini ya mgongo wake… Hivyo.
findings.objectiveReason: The Russian instruction places a hand under her back to support the weakened sister. mgongoni places it on/at the back and omits under; mweke can also imply putting her rather than the hand. Preserve the complete thanks, caution and final guiding fragment.

findings.source: Foreigner: (Вы улыбаетесь и показываете пальцем на улыбку, потом на собеседника.)
findings.currentTarget: Foreigner: (Unatabasamu na kunyooshea kidole tabasamu lako, kisha kumwonyesha mzungumzaji.)
findings.proposedFullTarget: Foreigner: (Unatabasamu na kunyooshea kidole tabasamu lako, kisha kumnyooshea kidole mzungumzaji.)
findings.objectiveReason: The same pointing gesture targets the smile and then the interlocutor. kumwonyesha mzungumzaji means showing the interlocutor something, rather than pointing a finger at him. Preserve the full parenthetical action, actor and gesture order.

findings.source: Alt: Я ничего не имею против показать подмышки.
findings.currentTarget: Alt: Sina tatizo kukuonyesha kwapa zangu.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Alt: Sina tatizo kukuonyesha makwapa yangu.
findings.objectiveReason: The named object is plural armpits. Approved glossary and prior adjudication use kwapa/makwapa, class 5/6; kwapa zangu gives it class 10 agreement. Use explicit plural makwapa with yangu; preserve the speaker’s lack of objection.

findings.source: Experienced: Я, конечно, понимаю, что зрелище не из приятных — подмышки мои увидеть…
findings.currentTarget: Experienced: Naelewa kwamba si jambo la kupendeza kuona kwapa zangu…
findings.proposedFullTarget: Experienced: Naelewa kwamba si jambo la kupendeza kuona makwapa yangu…
findings.objectiveReason: The explicit plural armpits require makwapa yangu, following approved class 5/6 kwapa/makwapa usage, rather than kwapa zangu. Preserve the ellipsis and the full acknowledgment that the sight is unpleasant.

The normal-player branch explicitly describes armpits with hair. Kwapa zina uses class 10 agreement with kwapa; the approved plural is makwapa, class 6, requiring yana. Preserve the positive hair finding and leave the adjacent normality statement unchanged.

findings.source: GraveDigger: Если уж тебя мои подмышки испугали, то лучше не смотри, что в душе творится.
findings.currentTarget: GraveDigger: Kama kwapa zangu zimekutisha, ni bora usiangalie kinachoendelea rohoni mwangu.
findings.proposedFullTarget: GraveDigger: Kama makwapa yangu yamekutisha, ni bora usiangalie kinachoendelea rohoni mwangu.
findings.objectiveReason: The subject explicitly names the speaker’s plural armpits, so makwapa yangu yamekutisha is required by the approved class 5/6 noun usage. kwapa zangu zimekutisha incorrectly gives them class 10 agreement. Preserve the whole conditional contrast with turmoil in his soul.

findings.source: Scammer: Ну сам подумай, у нормального пацана не могут быть палёные подмышки.
findings.currentTarget: Scammer: Fikiria mwenyewe; mtu wa kawaida hawezi kuwa na kwapa za kutia shaka.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Scammer: Fikiria mwenyewe; mtu wa kawaida hawezi kuwa na makwapa ya kutia shaka.
findings.objectiveReason: The named plural armpits require makwapa ya, not kwapa za, under the approved class 5/6 noun usage. Preserve the normal-person denial and suspicious-sign qualifier in the complete sentence.

findings.currentTarget: FunnyGuy: Basi angalia, kwa nini nisiangalie.
findings.proposedFullTarget: FunnyGuy: Basi angalia, kwa nini usiangalie.
findings.objectiveReason: The speaker grants the player permission to look at his ears; ShowSign FunnyGuy EAR immediately follows. nisiangalie changes the rhetorical subject to the speaker (why should I not look), conflicting with the preceding player imperative. usiangalie preserves the player as the examiner.

findings.source: Fairytaller: На всякий случай постараюсь почаще мыть их.
findings.currentTarget: Fairytaller: Kwa tahadhari, nitajaribu kuyaosha mara nyingi zaidi.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Fairytaller: Kwa tahadhari, nitajaribu kuosha mikono yangu mara nyingi zaidi.
findings.objectiveReason: The scene concerns the speaker’s hands, with a scar on them and an optional dirty-nails branch. kuyaosha refers to class 6 objects, agreeing with neither mikono (class 4) nor kucha (class 10). Explicit kuosha mikono yangu preserves the washing intention in both branches without retaining an incorrect object prefix.
